paite: Huai ni chiangin TOUPAN, a namsau hoihtaka hiam, lianpi, muanhuaitakin, leviathan gulpi hattak leh leviathan gulpi kivial ngeingoi a gawt dinga, tuipi-a dragon om leng a that ding.
english: In that day, Yahweh with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan the twisted serpent; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.

paite: Huai ni chiangin: Uain grep huan khat, huai pahtawiin lasa un.
english: In that day, sing to her, “A pleasant vineyard!

paite: Kei TOUPA lah a vengpa ka hi a; mitphiatkal tengin tui ka buak dinga, kuamahin a khoih louh ding un sun leh janin ka veng ding.
english: I, Yahweh, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.

paite: Keiah hehna a om kei hi: loulingnei leh khaulingneiten hondouin honsual him le u aw! amau sual din ka kuan dinga, mun khatah ka hal lunglung ding.
english: Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn them together.

paite: A hih kei lelah, hon kileppihna dingin ka hatna len hen: ahi, honkilep pih hen.
english: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me. Let him make peace with me.”

paite: Hun hontung dingah Jakobten zung a kha ding ua; Israelten zung a kha ding ua; Israelte a mum un a pak ding uh: huchiin leitung gahin adimsak ding uhi.
english: In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.

paite: Amah vote a vuak bang letin amah a vo sam ahia? a hih kei leh, amah thahte thahna bang letin amah thahin a om hia?
english: Has he struck them as he struck those who struck them? Or are they killed like those who killed them were killed?

paite: Amah na pai mangsak laiin a hun lelin amah na sela: suahlam huih nun niin a hu thupitakin amah a mutlengta hi.
english: In measure, when you send them away, you contend with them. He has removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.

paite: Huaijiakin hiaiin Jakobte thulimlouhna silsiang ahi dinga, hiai a khelhna uh pai mangpihna gah ngen ahi: Asherim hiam, gimlim maitamte hiam ding nawn lou ding khopin maitam suang tengteng suang pak den khap zeizoi bangin a bawl uhi.
english: Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are beaten in pieces, so that the Asherim and the incense altars shall rise no more.

paite: Khua kulhpi nei lah a lungjuanga, omna nutsiat leh paisan, gamdai bang ahi: huailaiah bawngnou a ta dinga, huailai mahah a kual dinga, a selte a ne ding.
english: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness. The calf will feed there, and there he will lie down, and consume its branches.

paite: A hiangte lah a vuai chiang un khiahin a om dinga; numeite a hongpai ding ua a hal ding uh: amau lah theihtheihna himhim neilou mi ahi ngal ua: huaijiakin amau bawlpan amaute a hehpih kei dinga, amaute sutuahpan amaute deihsakna himhim a neikei ding hi.
english: When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people of no understanding. Therefore he who made them will not have compassion on them, and he who formed them will show them no favor.

paite: Huan, huai niin hichi ahi dinga, TOUPAN, Lui a kuang dima luang zoizoi akipanin, Aigupta luita phain, a gah a sat khe dinga, huchiin, Israel suante aw, khatkhata simin na om ding uhi.Huan, huai niin hichi ahi dinga, pengkul lianpi a mut ding ua: huchiin Assuria gama mangthang dekdekte leh, Aigupta gama delhkhiaka omte a hongpai ding ua: Jerusalem khuaa tang siangthouah TOUPA a be ding uhi.
english: It will happen in that day, that Yahweh will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, children of Israel.

paite: Huan, huai niin hichi ahi dinga, pengkul lianpi a mut ding ua: huchiin Assuria gama mangthang dekdekte leh, Aigupta gama delhkhiaka omte a hongpai ding ua: Jerusalem khuaa tang siangthouah TOUPA a be ding uhi.
english: It will happen in that day that a great trumpet will be blown; and those who were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and those who were outcasts in the land of Egypt, shall come; and they will worship Yahweh in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.
